name: stem_dpo_benchmark
description: A benchmark consisting of human preference data for STEM-related model outputs intended to evaluate Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) and other preference-learning methods. It measures how well models align with human judgments on correctness, clarity, and helpfulness for STEM queries, typically via pairwise comparisons. The dataset is used to train and evaluate preference/ranking-based fine-tuning approaches rather than traditional supervised prediction.
reputation: A niche dataset used by researchers working on preference learning and alignment in STEM domains; limited broad adoption so far.
